description: Wait until a TCP port accepts connections, or until nothing listens there with --gone

gone.description: Wait until nothing listens there instead

target.description: A port on this machine such as 5432, host:port, [IPv6]:port, or a URL whose scheme gives the port

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up, from 1 to 3600; 60 by default <seconds>

name: wait.port

address.description: From the last attempt: the address that answered, or why nothing did.

code.description: The operating system's error code, such as ECONNREFUSED.

gone.description: Waiting until nothing listens, rather than until something does.

output.description: What a program the command ran printed

truncated.description: Where the result was cut to fit, and how much
